operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Nakba Day 78: Strikes Intensify Across Gaza on Day 5 of Renewed Campaign; UN Security Council Debates Ceasefire Collapse
heroSubtitle: On May 15, 2026 — the 78th anniversary of the Nakba — IDF continued intensive air and ground strikes across eastern Gaza City and Khan Younis (Day 947 / Day 5 of the renewed military campaign authorized May 10). ACLED confirmed a 35% increase in Israeli attacks in Gaza in April vs. March. Palestinians worldwide and inside Gaza marked the Nakba anniversary — with the Washington Post reporting Gazans saying 'today's catastrophe is worse' than 1948. The UN Security Council held an open debate (SC16284) on ceasefire consolidation, with UN officials documenting 875+ Palestinian deaths since the October 2025 ceasefire and condemning the breakdown of Phase 2 negotiations. Board of Peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov's May 14 warning that Gaza risks permanent territorial partition — with the IDF's Orange Line controlling 64% of the Strip — dominated diplomatic commentary. Hamas began its succession process after the May 13 killing of Mohammed Sinwar, with Khalil al-Hayya and Khaled Mashaal emerging as frontrunners for the new Hamas chief. Egypt's 196th humanitarian convoy entered via Rafah auxiliary gate, but at only 110 trucks/day vs. 600+ required. Total Palestinian death toll: 72,756+ killed since October 7, 2023.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, IMEMC, CNN, Washington Post, UN Press, Chatham House, ACLED. Gaza death toll: 72,756+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (IMEMC/WAFA, May 15, 2026). 875+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire (2,500+ wounded). IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Day 3 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar killed in tunnel beneath Gaza European Hospital. Day 4 (May 14): Orange Line = 64% control; UNRWA disease outbreak warnings. Day 5 (May 15 / Nakba Day 78): Intensive strikes in Gaza City and Khan Younis; UNSC debate SC16284; Hamas succession begins (al-Hayya, Mashaal). UNRWA staff killed: 391. Only 17 of 36 hospitals partially functional. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, under 10% funded. Day 947 of war.
